FOTU-End1.3.full: It feels like ages since I have written. The village that we once sojourned to all those years ago has fallen silent. It's crumbling defenses are a reminder; a metaphor for the crippling isolation of xenophobia. Even now I remember those accursed city walls that sapped my youthful vitality with every visit into the murky depths of that place; a place that could never be rebuilt after the hideous Experiment was unleashed.
FOTU-End1.3.easy: It feels like a very long time since I last wrote. The village we stayed in all those years ago has become silent. Its walls, which are falling down, remind me of how terribly lonely a town becomes when it fears strangers. Even now I remember those cursed city walls. Every time I went into that dark place, they took away a little of my young energy. It was a place that could never be built again after the horrible Experiment was let loose.
FOTU-End1.3.short: It has been ages since I wrote. The village we visited long ago has fallen silent, its crumbling walls a monument to the isolation of xenophobia. I still remember how they drained me; that place could never be rebuilt after the Experiment was unleashed.

FOTU-End1.4.full: Yet, even now the indomitable pull of my family's infamous work tears at my very soul! No. I cannot carry on a legacy of fear that left an entire town and estate in ruins. My colleagues at the university have no reverence for me. They laugh so heartily when I tell them the town in which I was birthed. I do not blame them. My hope is that I shall never see that foul place again. How could my family cultivate such an embarrassing line of thinking?
FOTU-End1.4.easy: But even now, the strong pull of my family's famous and terrible work tears at my soul! No. I cannot continue a family tradition of fear that left a whole town and our house in ruins. My colleagues at the university do not respect me. They laugh loudly when I tell them which town I was born in. I do not blame them. I hope I will never see that horrible place again. How could my family follow such an embarrassing way of thinking?
FOTU-End1.4.short: Yet my family's infamous work still tugs at my soul! No. I cannot carry on a legacy that ruined a whole town. My colleagues laugh at my birthplace, and I do not blame them. I hope never to see it again.

FOTU-End1.5.full: As I pen this note, my lawyer has made arrangements for a transfer of ownership; the deed to that wretched estate will soon finally be wrested from my hands and with it, the insidious efforts contained within will be buried forever.
FOTU-End1.5.easy: As I write this note, my lawyer has prepared everything to give the property to someone else. Soon the papers for that terrible house will finally be taken from my hands, and with them, the evil work inside will be buried forever.
FOTU-End1.5.short: My lawyer is arranging the transfer; soon the deed to that wretched estate, and the evil work within, will be gone from my hands forever.

FOTU-End2.3.full: I see now how wrong I had been. True inspiration, true science, true art, it emerges from isolation. Isolation is the catalyst. With silence and contemplation, the ability to truly focus without distractions, this is where perfection and enlightenment is achieved.
FOTU-End2.3.easy: Now I see how wrong I was. Real inspiration, real science, real art comes from being alone. Being alone is what starts it. With silence and deep thought, and the ability to really focus without anything to disturb you, that is how you reach perfection and true understanding.
FOTU-End2.3.short: I see now how wrong I was. True inspiration, science and art emerge from isolation. In silence and focus, perfection is achieved.

FOTU-End2.4.full: The citizens of {0} were right in their decision. Outside influences only pollute the mind and distract.
FOTU-End2.4.easy: The citizens of {0} made the right decision. Influences from outside only make the mind dirty and take away your focus.

FOTU-End2.5.full: One must be self-reliant and self-motivated. Science is instinctual. Brilliance doesn't come from universities. No one was ever remembered as the world's greatest team player. No.
FOTU-End2.5.easy: You must depend on yourself and push yourself. Science comes from your natural feelings. Great ideas do not come from universities. Nobody was ever remembered as the best team player in the world. No.
FOTU-End2.5.short: One must be self-reliant. Science is instinct, not a university matter. No one is remembered as the greatest team player.

FOTU-End2.6.full: The rest of the world may be unaware of my family's work, but that is all part of my ingenious plan. Today, I retreat to my laboratory. Soon, I will emerge from my scientific cocoon more brilliant than ever before and the world will tremble at my feet!
FOTU-End2.6.easy: The rest of the world may not know about my family's work, but that is all part of my clever plan. Today, I go back to my laboratory. Soon I will come out of my scientific shell, more brilliant than ever, and the world will shake at my feet!
FOTU-End2.6.short: The world may not know my family's work, but that is part of my plan. I retreat to my laboratory, to emerge more brilliant than ever, and the world will tremble at my feet!

IsoIdentification.5.full: After an extended time, I was reluctantly approved. I bundled up my papers and my wits and beat a quick path to my hansom, where the horses stamped at my approach and appeared to be just as keen as I was to leave this wretched place.
IsoIdentification.5.easy: After a long time, they agreed to let me in, even though they did not want to. I took my papers, tried to stay calm, and walked quickly to my carriage. The horses moved their feet when I came, and they seemed just as eager as I was to leave this terrible place.
IsoIdentification.5.short: At length, I was reluctantly approved, and hurried to my hansom, whose horses seemed as eager as I was to leave.

SmugEvent2ACont.4.full: Experiment Notes - A Fabric That Cannot Become Stained:
SmugEvent2ACont.4.easy: Experiment Notes - A Cloth That Can Never Get Dirty:

SmugEvent2ACont.5.full: While seemingly innocuous, our amazingly versatile fabric that could not be stained also appeared to have the more important side effect of repelling all possible stain sources with vicious force. Upon offering our fabric as a possible alternative for the town's flag, the light cloth explosively began to ascend and descend in mid-air, flapping wildly about the room. We fled City Hall and watched in mild amusement and terror as the experiment destroyed the building entirely within seconds.
SmugEvent2ACont.5.easy: It seemed harmless, but our amazingly useful cloth that could not get dirty also had a more important side effect: it pushed away everything that could make it dirty, with terrible force. When we offered our cloth as a new choice for the town's flag, the light cloth suddenly flew up and down in the air with great force and moved wildly around the room. We ran out of City Hall and watched, a little amused and a little afraid, as the experiment destroyed the whole building in seconds.
SmugEvent2ACont.5.short: Our unstainable fabric also violently repelled anything that might stain it. Offered as the town's new flag, it began flapping wildly through the air. We fled City Hall and watched, amused and terrified, as it destroyed the building within seconds.

SmugEvent2ACont.6.full: Experiment Notes - A Robot Servant That Prepares Meals with Lasers:
SmugEvent2ACont.6.easy: Experiment Notes - A Robot Servant That Cooks Meals with Lasers:

SmugEvent2ACont.7.full: Possibly a flawed idea from the beginning and admittedly not our best overall craftsmanship, the robot butler almost immediately began to indscriminantly fire lasers literally everywhere. Our demonstration was very brief in City Hall, before we all retreated to a safer distance and observed the easily avoidable chaos that we had caused. The City Hall was engulfed in flames in minutes. Dreadful, really.
SmugEvent2ACont.7.easy: Maybe it was a bad idea from the start, and I admit it was not our best work. The robot servant almost immediately began to shoot lasers everywhere, at everything. Our show in City Hall was very short. Then we all went back to a safer distance and watched the chaos we had caused, which could easily have been avoided. In minutes, City Hall was on fire. Terrible, really.
SmugEvent2ACont.7.short: Perhaps flawed from the start, the robot butler immediately fired lasers in every direction. We retreated from City Hall and watched it go up in flames within minutes. Dreadful, really.

SmugEvent2ACont.8.full: Experiment Notes - Injecting an Agitated Gorilla with Hormones and Radium:
SmugEvent2ACont.8.easy: Experiment Notes - Giving an Angry Gorilla Injections of Hormones and Radium:

SmugEvent2ACont.9.full: The cage in which our great primate was displayed was woefully inadequate, and upon the slightest provocation it emerged violently from its enclosure at the very beginning of our exhibition at City Hall. Covered in a disturbing amount of blood and viscera within seconds, the inevitable mistake rampaged through the room in a whirlwind of coffee and silver fur. We exited hastily to observe from a more appropriate distance as a hailstorm of shattered bones showered the nearby streets.
SmugEvent2ACont.9.easy: The cage that showed our great ape was much too weak. At the smallest provocation, the ape broke violently out of it at the very start of our show at City Hall. In seconds, it was covered in a horrible amount of blood and flesh, and this mistake, which was always going to happen, ran wild through the room in a storm of coffee and silver fur. We left quickly to watch from a safer distance as a storm of broken bones fell on the streets nearby.
SmugEvent2ACont.9.short: The gorilla's cage was hopelessly weak; at the slightest provocation it burst out at the start of our exhibition. Soon covered in gore, it rampaged through the room, and from a safe distance we watched shattered bones rain on the streets.

SmugEvent2ACont.10.full: However, undaunted, the Experiment continued its path of destruction until we were able to subdue it with our hastily prepared antidotal serum.
SmugEvent2ACont.10.easy: But without fear, the Experiment continued to destroy everything in its path, until we were able to stop it with an antidote that we had made in a hurry.
SmugEvent2ACont.10.short: Undaunted, it kept rampaging until our hastily made antidote subdued it.

PEWitch2.2.full: I find with each passing evening that my parent's abhorrent obsessions boil beneath the surface of my everyday activities. Despite the village's push towards civility and the exploration of mental disabilities, I am unable to resist the clarion call of what could one day define our family's legacy!
PEWitch2.2.easy: Every evening, I feel more and more how my parents' terrible obsessions boil under the surface of my daily life. The village wants to be more civilized and to study illnesses of the mind, but I cannot resist the loud call of the work that could one day make our family's name!
PEWitch2.2.short: Each night my parents' terrible obsessions boil beneath my daily life. Though the village turns to civility, I cannot resist the call of what could define our family's legacy!

PEWitch2.4.full: The relapse of paranoid delusion in the rural populace has made life particularly anxious for those who express a scientific aptitude. However, considering that the region's continued hysteria keeps most inhabitants locked within their ashen homes at night, fearful of every shadow that flits across the windowsill, I am reasonably sure that my new obsessions will blend into the macabre scenery unnoticed.
PEWitch2.4.easy: The fear without reason has come back among the country people, and this has made life very nervous for people who are good at science. But in this region, the madness continues and keeps most people locked in their gray homes at night, afraid of every shadow that moves past the window. So I am fairly sure that my new obsessions will not be noticed in this dark and frightening place.
PEWitch2.4.short: The return of rural paranoia makes life tense for the scientifically minded. But with most locked indoors at night, fearing every shadow, my new obsessions should go unnoticed.

PEWitch2PlayerA.3.full: My lust for fame knows no boundaries. Whether fulfilled through ethical means or the mark of infamy, I was born with a yearning to be known both far and wide for my scientific exploits. These narcissistic thoughts plague my waking hours and infect my dreams!
PEWitch2PlayerA.3.easy: My wish to be famous has no limits. Whether I become famous in an honest way or for terrible things, I was born wanting to be known everywhere for my scientific adventures. These thoughts about myself trouble me all day and fill my dreams!
PEWitch2PlayerA.3.short: My lust for fame is boundless. Famous or infamous, I must be known far and wide for my science. These thoughts plague my days and dreams!

PEWitch2PlayerA.4.full: My thirst for knowledge is unquenchable. Each evening I search through ancient tomes and scholarly texts, scouring every printed word and mathematical formula as if it were the last I will ever read.
PEWitch2PlayerA.4.easy: My wish for knowledge can never be satisfied. Every evening I search through very old books and learned texts, and I read every printed word and every mathematical formula as if it were the last one I will ever read.
PEWitch2PlayerA.4.short: My thirst for knowledge is unquenchable. Each night I devour ancient tomes as if every word were my last.

PEWitch2PlayerA.5.full: I have spent days upon days locked away within my secret laboratory. It is as though my entire existence is singularly focused on the pursuit of scientific excellence. I do not care if it drives me mad! If my contributions can advance Science even by a minute amount it will all be worth it!
PEWitch2PlayerA.5.easy: I have spent day after day locked in my secret laboratory. It is as if my whole life has only one goal: to be excellent in science. I do not care if it makes me crazy! If my work can move Science forward even a tiny bit, it will all be worth it!
PEWitch2PlayerA.5.short: I have spent days locked in my secret laboratory, devoted to scientific excellence. Let it drive me mad! Any advance for Science is worth it!

PEWitch2PlayerA.6.full: I am surrounded by simple-minded human filth. How dare they look at such an affluent individual with judgement in their eyes? How dare they interfere with an aristocrat's greatest, most valuable work? Oh, they will PAY for their insolence!
PEWitch2PlayerA.6.easy: I am surrounded by simple, dirty people. How dare they look at a rich person like me and judge me with their eyes? How dare they stand in the way of a noble's greatest and most valuable work? Oh, they will PAY for their rudeness!
PEWitch2PlayerA.6.short: I am surrounded by simple-minded filth. How dare they judge me, or interfere with my work? They will PAY for their insolence!

PEWitch2PlayerA.7.full: I will not suffer fools. It is just as important for a peasant or a king to know their place in the presence of my genius. I will show them **all** how to pay homage to their betters. Soon there will be no way to ignore my inspirational presence and I will command respect!
PEWitch2PlayerA.7.easy: I will not accept fools. A farmer or a king must both know their place when they are near my genius. I will show them **all** how to honor people who are better than them. Soon nobody will be able to ignore how inspiring I am, and everyone will respect me!
PEWitch2PlayerA.7.short: I will not suffer fools. Peasant or king, all must know their place before my genius. I will teach them **all** to pay homage, and I will command respect!

PEWitch2PlayerA.8.full: I find pleasure in the simple act of experimentation. Every tested hypothesis is a delectable morsel to be savored. And is it not my obligation - my right - to share this sense of wonder with the world? The wretches deserve to be entertained - for what is life without spectacle and indulgence?
PEWitch2PlayerA.8.easy: I enjoy the simple act of doing experiments. Every idea that I test is a delicious little piece of food to enjoy slowly. And is it not my duty, my right, to share this feeling of wonder with the world? The poor people deserve to be entertained, because what is life without big shows and pleasure?
PEWitch2PlayerA.8.short: I relish experimentation; every hypothesis is a delicacy. Is it not my right to share this wonder? The wretches deserve a spectacle.

PEWitch3.4.full: The push towards acceptance has allowed the citizens a meager respite from superstition. Some even look upon the advancements of science and technology as curious amusements.
PEWitch3.4.easy: The movement towards acceptance has given the citizens a short break from superstition. Some people even see new science and technology as interesting entertainment.
PEWitch3.4.short: Acceptance has eased superstition a little; some even find science and technology amusing.

PEWitch3.6.full: With the failure of government institutions causing a stressful atmosphere in the town, the people are again wary of the things that they cannot fully understand.
PEWitch3.6.easy: Government institutions have failed, and this has made the town tense. So people are careful again about things they cannot fully understand.
PEWitch3.6.short: Failing institutions have made the town tense, and people are wary again of what they cannot understand.

PEWitch3.8.full: An inclusive economy has reinvigorated the progressive ideals of the populace. Within years, this once guarded village has begun to embrace concepts of the future and to leave behind the ways of old.
PEWitch3.8.easy: An economy that includes everyone has given the people new energy for modern ideas. In a few years, this village, which was once so closed, has started to accept ideas about the future and to leave the old ways behind.
PEWitch3.8.short: An inclusive economy has revived progressive ideals, and the once guarded village is embracing the future.

BattleIntro.9.full: A sudden hiss of steam burst from the edges of the arena as my warrior took its place on the cracked earth alongside my cousin's. The sound of rusted metal clanging against the cage by the throngs of spectators heralded a stinging trumpet blast. With a final volley of flames, the battle had begun!
BattleIntro.9.easy: Suddenly, steam hissed out from the edges of the arena as my warrior took its place on the cracked ground next to my cousin's. The crowds of watchers hit rusty metal against the cage, and then a sharp trumpet sounded. With one last burst of flames, the battle had begun!
BattleIntro.9.short: Steam hissed as my warrior took its place beside my cousin's. The crowd clanged metal on the cage, a trumpet blared, and with a burst of flames the battle began!

BattleEnd.3.full: {0}{1}{2}{3}{4} emerged from the turbid pit of blood, oil, and iron to be crowned champion that day.
BattleEnd.3.easy: {0}{1}{2}{3}{4} came out of the dirty pit of blood, oil, and iron and was made champion that day.

BattleEnd.4.full: I have struck the images from my mind, but the savage discipline {0} afforded to each of my cousins for their failure was as swift as it was sanguinary. With heads literally severed from their households, I will be able to live out my final years in isolated study as the sole living member of this generation. I will relish this victory.
BattleEnd.4.easy: I have removed the pictures from my mind, but the cruel punishment that {0} gave each of my cousins for losing was as fast as it was bloody. Their heads were really cut off, and now I am the only one of this generation who is still alive. I will spend my last years studying alone. I will enjoy this victory.
BattleEnd.4.short: I have struck it from my mind, but {0}'s punishment of my cousins was swift and bloody. With their heads severed, I alone of my generation remain, free to study in isolation. I will relish this victory.

JunkPalaceMeet1.3.full: {0} stood and wiped her lips, and unceremoniously spit upon the floor. She bid me follow her to a portion of the jail where a large section of the second floor had collapsed and we could look out over the perverted land, its dismal cracks and ruddy mires stretching out for nearly a kilometer.
JunkPalaceMeet1.3.easy: {0} stood up, wiped her lips, and spat on the floor without any manners. She told me to follow her to a part of the prison where a large part of the second floor had fallen down. From there we could look out over the ruined land, with its sad cracks and red mud reaching out for almost a kilometer.
JunkPalaceMeet1.3.short: {0} stood, wiped her lips and spat on the floor, then led me to where the jail's second floor had collapsed, overlooking the ruined land: cracks and red mires for nearly a kilometer.

JunkPalaceMeet1.4.full: {0} stood up from the table where he had been enjoying a feast and crudely wiped his lips on his stained apron. He took me aside to speak privately. As privately as we could, being surrounded by three of his most loyal followers. They carried makeshift weapons with barbed wire wrapped around cudgeled ends and wore a similar thick apron to {1}.
JunkPalaceMeet1.4.easy: {0} stood up from the table where he had been enjoying a big meal, and wiped his lips roughly on his dirty apron. He took me to one side to speak privately. Well, as privately as we could, with three of his most loyal followers around us. They carried simple weapons, clubs with barbed wire around the ends, and wore thick aprons like {1}.
JunkPalaceMeet1.4.short: {0} rose from his feast, wiped his lips on his stained apron and took me aside, as privately as three loyal followers allowed. They carried barbed-wire cudgels and wore aprons like {1}'s.

JunkPalaceMeet1.5.full: {0} spoke. "Since you have finally come down from your perch, I will reward you with an offer. For a minor sum, I will make sure your reputation around here is indisputable."
JunkPalaceMeet1.5.easy: {0} spoke. "Since you have finally come down from your high place, I will reward you with an offer. For a small amount of money, I will make sure that everyone here knows your name and nobody questions it."

JunkPalaceMeet1.6.full: As you no doubt have realized from the dramatic retelling of this meeting that I have offered, I was skeptical of {0}'s tone. "I assure you, I will spread knowledge of your experiments. All of Transylvania will fear you - at least, more than they already do. I want them to *hate* you as I do."
JunkPalaceMeet1.6.easy: As you have surely understood from the exciting way I tell this story, I did not trust the way {0} spoke. "I promise you, I will tell people about your experiments. All of Transylvania will fear you, at least more than they already do. I want them to *hate* you like I do."
JunkPalaceMeet1.6.short: I distrusted {0}'s tone. "I will spread word of your experiments. All Transylvania will fear you, more than they already do. I want them to *hate* you as I do."

JunkPalaceMeetb.3.full: I was anxious to leave this desolate place, so when the {0} nodded towards the exit, I sprang quickly at the opportunity and left at a brisk pace.
JunkPalaceMeetb.3.easy: I wanted to leave this empty, sad place, so when the {0} nodded towards the exit, I took the chance at once and walked away fast.

JunkPalaceMeetb.4.full: As I walked, {0} pointed to a large individual who remained concealed in the shadows. The Creature noticed our attention and disappeared from view. "Your family could not help that poor creature, so I have not and will not reveal to you what will befall if you do not impress me *(reach the end of the {icon:Creepy_Icon} Track)*. But **if you do not reach the end, there will be a penalty**. It is best you do not find out what."

JunkPalaceMeetb.5.full: {0} honored their word and I received the encouragement I had chosen.
JunkPalaceMeetb.5.easy: {0} kept their promise, and I received the support I had chosen.

JailEvent1b.3.full: And so it is now that I am tolerated while I am still useful. {0} demands tribute from me, but this oppressive edict carries with it a freedom to explore all potential scientific avenues without the rigors of academia or the scrutiny of the public. With each visit to the town, I witness sights that stick with me like tar underneath the fingernails.
JailEvent1b.3.easy: And so now they accept me while I am still useful. {0} demands payment from me. But this cruel rule also gives me the freedom to explore every possible kind of science, without the strict rules of the university or the eyes of the public. Every time I visit the town, I see things that stay with me like tar under my fingernails.
JailEvent1b.3.short: So I am tolerated while useful. {0} demands tribute, but in return I am free to pursue any science, unchecked by academia or the public. Each visit to town leaves sights that cling like tar under my fingernails.

JailEvent1b.4.full: However, the moment my servants enter the town limits, they are harassed by the inhabitants and driven back to the estate for sanctuary. But my loyal caretaker's disposition and appearance meshes exceedingly well with the locals, allowing them to enjoy a new sense of freedom.
JailEvent1b.4.easy: But as soon as my servants go into the town, the people there attack them with words and chase them back to the house for safety. But my loyal caretaker's character and looks fit very well with the local people, so they can enjoy a new kind of freedom.
JailEvent1b.4.short: My servants are harassed and driven home whenever they enter town. But my loyal caretaker fits in perfectly with the locals and enjoys a new freedom.

JailEvent1b.5.full: Perhaps over time this will change, but with the world turned upside down, I suspect some adaptation will be required.
JailEvent1b.5.easy: Maybe this will change with time, but now that the world is upside down, I think we will need to adapt a little.

TensionSetting.3.full: I'm sure it is nothing, yet I feel compelled to jot it down in these pages. Unrelated note: I should have the caretaker check that the gate hinges are reinforced and the fencing spikes sharpened. The devil goes away when he finds the door shut against him.

AsylumSignIn.2.full: The meager facility appeared bleak and outdated from its exterior; less a haven for the mentally ill and more a glorified tavern. Yet upon entering, I found the halls clean and the separation between patient quarters and caregiver offices to be adequate.
AsylumSignIn.2.easy: From the outside, the small building looked sad and old. It looked less like a safe place for people with illnesses of the mind and more like a big inn. But inside, I found that the halls were clean, and the patients' rooms were separated well enough from the offices of the staff.
AsylumSignIn.2.short: From outside, the shabby facility looked more like a tavern than an asylum, but inside the halls were clean and the wards properly separated.

AsylumSignIn.3.full: **I gave my name to the receptionist:**

AsylumComplete.3.full: The most unusual thing happened to me the other day. I am almost embarrassed to state it.
AsylumComplete.3.easy: A very strange thing happened to me the other day. I am almost too embarrassed to say it.

AsylumComplete.4.full: I decided to visit the new Asylum in town to inspect the structure and determine its suitability for further research and investment. I had a startling sense of déjà vu upon entering the institution which was further exacerbated by the puzzled look of the receptionist when I gave my name at the door. I think she half expected me to turn myself in.
AsylumComplete.4.easy: I decided to visit the new Asylum in town to look at the building and decide if it was good for more research and investment. When I went in, I had a strong feeling that I had already been there before. This feeling became stronger when the woman at the desk looked confused when I gave my name at the door. I think she half expected me to give myself up as a patient.
AsylumComplete.4.short: I visited the new Asylum to judge it for research and investment. Inside, I felt a strong déjà vu, made worse by the receptionist's puzzled look at my name. I think she half expected me to turn myself in.

AsylumComplete.5.full: Suddenly it came back to me that I had already visited for the first time and apparently don't follow instructions very well. Appreciatively, I was given a small sedative before exiting the halls of the laughing academy once more.
AsylumComplete.5.easy: Suddenly I remembered that I had already been there once, and it seems I am not very good at following instructions. Kindly, they gave me a small medicine to calm me before I left the halls of the madhouse again.
AsylumComplete.5.short: Then I remembered: I had already visited, and evidently don't follow instructions well. They kindly gave me a small sedative on the way out.

BusinessMeetb.4.full: At length, the Count brought up the business at hand. "I enjoy tradition. Unlike the wiles of modern philosophies which sway in and out of vogue, I believe that investment should be based not solely on the kindness of one's heart and a vague promise, but on real trade. I gain some thing, you gain some thing."
BusinessMeetb.4.easy: After some time, the Count started to talk about business. "I like tradition. Modern ideas come in and out of fashion. But I believe that investment should not only come from a kind heart and an unclear promise, but from real trade. I get something, you get something."
BusinessMeetb.4.short: At length, the Count turned to business. "I prefer tradition to fashionable philosophies. Investment should rest on real trade, not kindness and vague promises. I gain something, you gain something."

BusinessMeetb.5.full: He ventured that he had an offer that would intrigue me.
BusinessMeetb.5.easy: He said he had an offer that would interest me.

S4Asylum2.2.easy: For a generous gift, the Asylum will offer a new service to anyone in our family who may be interested: the Asylum has chosen a **{0}** program for the people who give them the most money. Investing money could help pay for more good changes in the town, but would the investment be worth it?
S4Asylum2.2.short: For a generous donation, the Asylum offers our family a **{0}** program for premium contributors. It could fund further progress in town, but is it worth it?

Payment1NoE.3.full: "Our employer will not be pleased by this decision," the other man hissed, then raised his ebony cloak just below his eyes and made a hasty, yet graceful exit from my Estate with his followers in tow. The insinuative nerve of that individual! Why they would not contact the executor to settle their minor financial quibbles is beyond my understanding!
Payment1NoE.3.easy: "Our employer will not be happy with this decision," the other man said angrily. Then he raised his black cloak up to just below his eyes and left my house quickly but elegantly, with his men behind him. How rude of that person to suggest such a thing! I cannot understand why they did not contact the person who handles the inheritance to solve their small money problems!
Payment1NoE.3.short: "Our employer will not be pleased," the other hissed, raising his ebony cloak and sweeping out with his followers. The nerve! Why not take such minor quibbles to the executor?

Payment1ThanksE.3.full: The men were pleased with my generous decision and pledged to never return again. Though they expressed themselves firmly, I was impressed to see them turn and gracefully exit without leaving a single speck of dust upon the carpeted entryway.
Payment1ThanksE.3.easy: The men were happy with my generous decision and promised never to come back. They spoke firmly, but I was impressed that they turned and left elegantly, without leaving one bit of dust on the carpet at the entrance.
Payment1ThanksE.3.short: Pleased with my generosity, the men promised never to return, and left gracefully without a speck of dust on the carpet.

PrivateCountCure.3.full: An ominous note appeared at my bedside table just the other day. It was written in precise calligraphy on thick pearl paper pressed with an intricate filigree at the edges. "The debt has been repaid," it stated in bright red ink. That very same morning, I felt a dull ache and subsequently discovered two blemishes upon my neck, like mosquito bites, one above the other spaced about five centimeters apart.
PrivateCountCure.3.easy: A worrying note appeared on the table beside my bed just the other day. It was written in careful, beautiful handwriting on thick white paper with fine decorations at the edges. "The debt has been repaid," it said in bright red ink. That same morning, I felt a dull pain, and then I found two marks on my neck, like mosquito bites, one above the other, about five centimeters apart.
PrivateCountCure.3.short: An ominous note appeared by my bed, in fine calligraphy on pearl paper: "The debt has been repaid," in bright red ink. That morning I felt a dull ache and found two marks on my neck, like mosquito bites, five centimeters apart.

PrivateCountCure.4.full: Ever since, I have felt reinvigorated; strong of heart and pure of will. I find myself in a more talkative mood, and when I speak, people listen more intently. My accent has become slightly more pronounced, and I struggle to pronounce my W's correctly.
PrivateCountCure.4.easy: Since then, I have felt full of new energy, with a strong heart and a clear will. I want to talk more, and when I speak, people listen more carefully. My accent has become a little stronger, and it is hard for me to say my W's correctly.
PrivateCountCure.4.short: Since then I have felt reinvigorated. I talk more, and people listen more closely. My accent has thickened, and I struggle with my W's.

S4CountCure.4.full: Strange, though expected occurrence today: The old man that I had once visited came to my doorstep. Though his dark garments were well-pressed, he walked with an unsteady step, seemingly enfeebled by his ailment.
S4CountCure.4.easy: A strange thing happened today, but I expected it: the old man I had once visited came to my door. His dark clothes were neatly ironed, but he walked unsteadily, as if his illness had made him weak.
S4CountCure.4.short: Today, as expected, the old man came to my door, his dark clothes well pressed but his step weak with illness.

S4CountCure.5.full: He was cordial, but desperate in his hope that I had procured the needed cure for his supernatural affliction.
S4CountCure.5.easy: He was polite, but he hoped desperately that I had found the cure he needed for his supernatural illness.

CountCureQuestion.6.full: Before I returned to my carriage, the old count entreated me once again, this time with words soft-spoken: "My friend," he spoke, "I understand that this will take some time to procure, but waiting is not something to which I am unaccustomed. I am in dire need of assistance from your alternative expertise. I am a vampyre."
CountCureQuestion.6.easy: Before I went back to my carriage, the old count asked me again, this time quietly: "My friend," he said, "I understand that it will take some time to find this, but I am used to waiting. I badly need help from your unusual knowledge. I am a vampyre."
CountCureQuestion.6.short: As I left, the old count spoke softly: "My friend, I know this will take time, but I am used to waiting. I need your unusual expertise. I am a vampyre."

CountCureQuestion.7.full: How he knew of my secret workings and why he then revealed the nature of his affliction I cannot know, but where the discovery would send a normal person into shock, the revelation delighted me.
CountCureQuestion.7.easy: I cannot know how he knew about my secret work, or why he told me about his illness. But this news, which would shock a normal person, made me very happy.
CountCureQuestion.7.short: How he knew of my secret work, I cannot say, but where others would be shocked, I was delighted.

CountCureQuestion.8.full: "I have lived too many years with this undying thirst for blood with which to sustain my youth. If you provide me a cure, I will offer you the same gift of strength and vitality that I myself have harbored all these years."
CountCureQuestion.8.easy: "I have lived too many years with this thirst for blood that never dies, which I need to stay young. If you give me a cure, I will give you the same gift of strength and life that I have had all these years."
CountCureQuestion.8.short: "I have thirsted for blood to keep my youth for too many years. Cure me, and I will give you the same gift of strength and vitality."

RareCreatureBonus.2.full: The Creature was not unrelenting in its vengeance. For upon the next morning, I discovered a heap of torn pages, scraps kept bundled in twine yet perfectly legible after all these years. Though my cousins and I had endured an unbearable hardship, my contribution was not left unrewarded.
RareCreatureBonus.2.easy: The Creature's revenge was not without end. The next morning, I found a pile of torn pages, pieces tied together with string, and still perfectly readable after all these years. My cousins and I had suffered terribly, but my help was not forgotten.
RareCreatureBonus.2.short: The Creature's vengeance was not without mercy. The next morning I found a bundle of torn pages, still legible after all these years. My contribution had been rewarded.

RareCreatureBonus.3.full: The player with a completed **Puppy** or **Bride** Experiment receives several torn pages from your grandfather's journal.

LibCountBlessing.3.full: An ominous note appeared at my bedside table just the other day. It was written in precise calligraphy on thick pearl paper pressed with an intricate filigree at the edges. "The debt has been repaid," it stated in bright red ink. That very same morning, I felt a dull ache and subsequently discovered two blemishes upon my neck, like mosquito bites, one above the other spaced about five centimeters apart.
LibCountBlessing.3.easy: A worrying note appeared on the table beside my bed just the other day. It was written in careful, beautiful handwriting on thick white paper with fine decorations at the edges. "The debt has been repaid," it said in bright red ink. That same morning, I felt a dull pain, and then I found two marks on my neck, like mosquito bites, one above the other, about five centimeters apart.
LibCountBlessing.3.short: An ominous note appeared by my bed, in fine calligraphy on pearl paper: "The debt has been repaid," in bright red ink. That morning I felt a dull ache and found two marks on my neck, like mosquito bites, five centimeters apart.

LibCountBlessing.4.full: Ever since, I have felt reinvigorated; strong of heart and pure of will. I find myself in a more talkative mood and when I speak, people listen more intently. My accent has become slightly more pronounced and I struggle to pronounce my W's correctly.
LibCountBlessing.4.easy: Since then, I have felt full of new energy, with a strong heart and a clear will. I want to talk more, and when I speak, people listen more carefully. My accent has become a little stronger, and it is hard for me to say my W's correctly.
LibCountBlessing.4.short: Since then I have felt reinvigorated. I talk more, and people listen more closely. My accent has thickened, and I struggle with my W's.

LiberalEventGood.3.full: Perhaps the world has some justice in it after all! A generous benefactor has intercepted our lobbying attempts and seen to it all debts were paid.
LiberalEventGood.3.easy: Maybe there is some justice in the world after all! A generous helper stepped in when we were trying to influence the politicians, and made sure that all debts were paid.
LiberalEventGood.3.short: Perhaps the world has some justice! A generous benefactor intercepted our lobbying and paid all debts.

LiberalEventGood.4.full: All I received was a brief letter where the local bank owner explained his reasoning thusly: "I have made a name for myself in the only field that doesn't care how ugly or vicious I am: business."
LiberalEventGood.4.easy: All I received was a short letter in which the owner of the local bank explained why: "I have made a name for myself in the only area that does not care how ugly or cruel I am: business."

LiberalEventGood.5.full: He signed his letter only as **The Creature**, but on a vivid egg-shell parchment bearing the bank's watermark. Who was this gentleman?
LiberalEventGood.5.easy: He signed his letter only as **The Creature**, but on bright white paper with the bank's mark on it. Who was this man?

LiberalEventGood.6.full: Any player who offered money towards the bribe regains all money spent and **gains 1 {icon:Creepy_Icon}.**

LiberalEvent3.2.full: It was only natural for my contributions to the Asylum to extend beyond the monetary. You are no doubt tired of hearing me repeat it, but their methods are timid and only mildly effective.
LiberalEvent3.2.easy: It was only natural that my help for the Asylum would be more than just money. You are surely tired of hearing me say it again, but their methods are too careful and only work a little.
LiberalEvent3.2.short: Naturally my contributions to the Asylum went beyond money. As I keep saying, their methods are timid and barely effective.

LiberalEvent3.3.full: The Asylum's direction has always been tenuous. With prevailing opinions shifting towards eugenics and heredity as unconquerable factors, they have received criticism from all arenas. I am skeptical of this new movement - perhaps I am always skeptical - for are we so resigned to the fate that god or biology has assigned to us? Can we not exercise our individual will and nurture better habits? Should we all throw up our hands and laze upon our daybeds lamenting our Mendelian inheritance?
LiberalEvent3.3.easy: The Asylum has never been sure of its direction. Now most people believe that race and what you inherit from your parents decide everything and cannot be changed, so the Asylum is criticized from all sides. I do not trust this new movement. Maybe I never trust anything. Must we simply accept the future that god or biology has given us? Can we not use our own will and learn better habits? Should we all give up, lie on our sofas, and complain about what we got from our parents?
LiberalEvent3.3.short: The Asylum's course has always been shaky, and with eugenics and heredity in fashion, it is criticized from all sides. I am skeptical. Must we accept the fate god or biology assigns us? Can we not cultivate better habits, rather than lament our Mendelian inheritance?

LiberalEvent3.4.full: I think it is high time for an innovative, aggressive new program to be introduced. I have scheduled a meeting with the Asylum's director. You do not need to wish me luck. I will be persuasive. A change is on the horizon.
LiberalEvent3.4.easy: I think it is time to start a new, modern, and strong program. I have planned a meeting with the director of the Asylum. You do not need to wish me luck. I will be convincing. Change is coming.
LiberalEvent3.4.short: It is time for a bold new program. I meet the Asylum's director soon, and I will be persuasive. Change is coming.

LiberalEvent3Resa.1.full: Please enter the name of your new rehabilitation program:

LiberalEvent3Resa.4.full: The Asylum has announced a radical change to their rehabilitative efforts, incorporating the most advanced alienist treatment regimen.
LiberalEvent3Resa.4.easy: The Asylum has announced a big change in the way it heals patients. It now uses the most modern treatment for illnesses of the mind.

LiberalEvent3Resa.5.full: A new wing of the facility displays the complex machinery utilized in this fascinating new therapy. Patients with varying degrees of dementia are carefully strapped to a hospital bed, while electrical pulses are concentrated upon different areas of the brain.
LiberalEvent3Resa.5.easy: A new part of the building shows the complicated machines used in this fascinating new treatment. Patients with different levels of madness are carefully tied to a hospital bed, while electric shocks are sent to different parts of the brain.
LiberalEvent3Resa.5.short: A new wing houses the machinery: patients are strapped to beds while electrical pulses are sent through their brains.

LiberalEvent3Resa.6.full: Using new advances in concentrated opiates, the doctors are able to administer strong sedatives to alleviate improper reflexes in patients. Through a combination of bloodletting and strong purgatives, the psychotic tendencies of the individual are allowed to exit the body.
LiberalEvent3Resa.6.easy: With new, stronger drugs made from opium, the doctors can give strong medicine to calm the patients' wrong reactions. By taking blood out of the body and by giving strong medicine that cleans the stomach, they let the madness leave the person's body.
LiberalEvent3Resa.6.short: Strong opiates calm improper reflexes, while bloodletting and purgatives draw the madness out of the body.

LiberalEvent3Resa.7.full: An entirely rebuilt surgical stage has been constructed where visiting physicians and the public alike can view the procedures as they are perfected. By removing the offending portions of brain tissue, or by alleviating pressures in the skull, the mentally ill experience a transformative effect which renders them placid and focused.
LiberalEvent3Resa.7.easy: A completely new operating stage has been built, where visiting doctors and the public can watch the operations as they are made better. The doctors remove the bad parts of the brain, or reduce the pressure inside the skull, and the patients change completely: they become calm and focused.
LiberalEvent3Resa.7.short: On a new surgical stage, visiting physicians and the public watch as brain tissue is removed or skull pressure relieved, leaving patients placid and focused.

LiberalEvent3Resa.8.full: While officials remain tight-lipped as to the details of the procedure, a bishop of the local diocese has been given residence to perform blessings to those whose will has been overcome by demons. Patients are isolated from stimulation, prescribed a "rest cure," and given a special restorative tonic of local roots and herbs.
LiberalEvent3Resa.8.easy: Officials do not say much about the details of the treatment, but a bishop from the local church now lives there and gives blessings to people whose will has been taken over by demons. Patients are kept away from anything exciting, they are told to have a "rest cure," and they get a special healing drink made of local roots and herbs.
LiberalEvent3Resa.8.short: Officials say little, but a resident bishop blesses the possessed, and patients are isolated, prescribed a "rest cure", and given a tonic of local roots and herbs.

LiberalEvent3Resa.9.full: While critics of the hospital remain outspoken, the progressive organization has embraced this change as proof that {0} remains the most modern psychiatric refuge in all of Transylvania.
LiberalEvent3Resa.9.easy: People who criticize the hospital still speak loudly, but the modern organization sees this change as proof that {0} is still the most modern place for treating the mind in all of Transylvania.
LiberalEvent3Resa.9.short: Critics remain vocal, but the hospital hails the change as proof that {0} is still Transylvania's most modern psychiatric refuge.

LiberalEvent3Resa.15.full: The player who has the second-most Experiments will also receive this Upgrade.

FOTU-End7.3.full: Patient exhibits no signs of previous paranoid delusions. Schizophrenic episodes have ceased though observation continues. Exercise regimen includes several unattended walks around the perimeter of the garden. Babbles repeatedly to themselves and others about "work left undone." Minor discomfort post-operation. 20 drops Tincture of Opium, dosed daily.
FOTU-End7.3.easy: Patient shows no signs of the earlier false fears. The episodes of madness have stopped, but we continue to watch. Exercise plan includes several walks alone around the edge of the garden. Talks to themselves and others again and again about "work that is not finished." Small pain after the operation. 20 drops of Opium Tincture every day.
FOTU-End7.3.short: No more paranoid delusions; episodes have ceased, observation continues. Several unattended walks in the garden. Keeps muttering about "work left undone." Minor post-operative discomfort. 20 drops Tincture of Opium daily.

FOTU-End7.4.full: Demeanor: calm, distant. Not atypical for this type of rehabilitation.
FOTU-End7.4.easy: Behavior: calm, far away. Normal for this kind of treatment.

FOTU-End7.5.full: Stitching area appears to have healed with no infection. Hair has begun to return around scarred area. Drill marks not noticeable.
FOTU-End7.5.easy: The stitched area seems to have healed without infection. Hair has started to grow again around the scar. The holes from the drill cannot be seen.

FOTU-End7.6.full: Physician Assessment: Removal of frontal lobe considered a success. Maintain continued observation protocol. Reassess potential for home care after six months.
FOTU-End7.6.easy: Doctor's opinion: The removal of the front part of the brain is considered a success. Keep watching the patient. Check again after six months if the patient can be cared for at home.

FOTU-End8.6.full: It is my hope that this letter finds you well. The news I hear from Bucharest is positive, with a seasonable chill in the air and continued peace. As such, I pray you will indulge me in forgoing pleasantries and moving to matters of business with haste.
FOTU-End8.6.easy: I hope this letter finds you well. The news I hear from Bucharest is good: the air is cool, as is normal for the season, and there is still peace. So I hope you will let me skip the polite words and go quickly to business.
FOTU-End8.6.short: I hope you are well; Bucharest sounds cool and peaceful. Forgive me if I skip pleasantries and turn to business.

FOTU-End8.7.full: The institution in {0} has been an unrivaled success. A steady stream of those suffering from insanities and delusions have been shipped here from other parts of the country. Yet still officials always wonder how we run such an efficient operation even as funding remains remarkably low. I believe it is in part due to the **{1} Program** which has gained notoriety across Europe for its aggressive tactics. Those involved in the studies have shown a tremendous improvement in behavior.
FOTU-End8.7.easy: The institution in {0} has been a great success, better than any other. A constant stream of people with madness and false beliefs has been sent here from other parts of the country. But officials always wonder how we can work so efficiently while we have so little money. I believe this is partly because of the **{1} Program**, which has become famous across Europe for its hard methods. The people who take part in the studies have shown a huge improvement in their behavior.
FOTU-End8.7.short: The institution in {0} is an unrivaled success, receiving the insane from across the country. Officials wonder how we run so efficiently on so little funding; partly, I believe, thanks to the **{1} Program**, notorious across Europe for its aggressive methods and remarkable results.

FOTU-End8.8.full: Which is why I must repeat my strong request from my previous letter: we require more fresh patients to treat. Our near one hundred percent release rate has left several vacancies in the facility and we are in dire need to obtain more.
FOTU-End8.8.easy: That is why I must repeat the strong request from my last letter: we need more new patients to treat. Almost all our patients leave us, so several places in the building are now empty, and we badly need to get more.
FOTU-End8.8.short: Hence I repeat my urgent request: we need more fresh patients. With nearly all of them released, we have vacancies to fill.

FOTU-End8.9.full: The concerns you expressed in your last letter are valid. What is the status of the released patients? How are we tracking their progress in society? How do you know we haven't simply been failing to treat them and then disposing of their bodies? Why are there bloodstains on the envelope of my previous letter? These are all important questions.
FOTU-End8.9.easy: The worries in your last letter are reasonable. What has happened to the patients who left? How are we following how well they do in society? How do you know that we have not just failed to treat them and then got rid of their bodies? Why is there blood on the envelope of my last letter? These are all important questions.
FOTU-End8.9.short: Your concerns are fair. What becomes of the released patients? How do we know we haven't simply failed them and disposed of the bodies? Why was my last envelope bloodstained? Important questions, all.

FOTU-End8.10.full: But, I ask you now; why question **results**?
FOTU-End8.10.easy: But I ask you now: why ask questions about **results**?

TaxesEventGood.3.full: Fortunately, as I arrived at the Town Hall to deliver my payment in person - yes, they impose a tax and then require me to courier it myself - a large gentleman in a well-tailored suit, wearing a large hat and a scarf about the bottom of his face stepped forward in my defense.
TaxesEventGood.3.easy: Luckily, when I arrived at the Town Hall to bring my payment in person (yes, they make a tax and then make me deliver it myself), a big man in a well-made suit stepped forward to defend me. He wore a large hat and a scarf over the lower part of his face.
TaxesEventGood.3.short: Luckily, as I arrived at the Town Hall to pay in person (yes, they make me deliver it myself), a large, well-dressed man with a hat and a scarf over his face stepped forward in my defense.

TaxesEventGood.4.full: "No. No. I will take care of this misunderstanding," the man grumbled in a low and powerful voice. He produced a fountain pen from his breast pocket and with a flick of his wrist, my estate tax was excused in full.
TaxesEventGood.4.easy: "No. No. I will take care of this mistake," the man said in a low, strong voice. He took a fountain pen from his chest pocket, and with a quick move of his hand, my whole property tax was cancelled.
TaxesEventGood.4.short: "No, I will take care of this," he rumbled, and with a flick of his fountain pen, my estate tax was excused in full.

TaxesEventGood.5.full: "As the owner of the premier lending institution in {0}, there are certain privileges I can indulge in for old friends," he stated confidentially. "Be sure to stop by some time and we can talk business."
TaxesEventGood.5.easy: "As the owner of the best bank in {0}, I have some special rights that I can use for old friends," he said quietly. "Come and visit me some time, and we can talk business."

TaxesEventGood.6.full: The creature winked, and his eye dangled from its socket with the motion. He quickly pressed it back into place with a gloved hand and made his exit before I could properly thank him. Who was that gentleman?
TaxesEventGood.6.easy: The creature winked, and with the movement his eye fell partly out of its place. He quickly pushed it back with his gloved hand and left before I could thank him properly. Who was that man?
TaxesEventGood.6.short: The creature winked, and his eye slipped from its socket. He pressed it back with a gloved hand and left before I could thank him. Who was that?

TaxesEventGood.7.full: Each player who chose to pay money to resolve their taxes recovers that amount back to their Quarters and **gains 2VP.**

PaymentOrDeathA.1.full: **Carefully hand this Storybook device to {0} and do not allow any other players to see the screen.**

PaymentOrDeathA.4.full: I write this note by candlelight as I have locked myself within the spandrel under the first floor stairs.
PaymentOrDeathA.4.easy: I am writing this note by candlelight, because I have locked myself in the small space under the stairs on the first floor.

PaymentOrDeathA.5.full: I do not know how they got past my defenses, but these pale individuals dressed in angular, coal-black suits came to my door seeking payment of an old debt. When my caretaker forbade them entry, they merely separated the double-door from its hinges without the use of weapons. Even now they skulk about, calling me by name and hissing like an alleycat protecting its meal.
PaymentOrDeathA.5.easy: I do not know how they got past my defenses, but these pale people in sharp, coal-black suits came to my door to collect an old debt. When my caretaker did not let them in, they simply took the double door off its hinges, without any weapons. Even now they move around secretly, calling my name and hissing like a street cat that protects its food.
PaymentOrDeathA.5.short: Somehow these pale figures in coal-black suits got past my defenses to collect an old debt. When my caretaker refused them, they simply lifted the doors off their hinges. Now they prowl, calling my name and hissing.

PaymentOrDeathA.6.full: They have just announced their intentions. The price has increased! They expect me to pay ${0} to them immediately or they will **KILL** me. Damn it all, I hear them pressing near!
PaymentOrDeathA.6.easy: They have just said what they want. The price has gone up! They want me to pay them ${0} at once, or they will **KILL** me. Curse it all, I hear them coming closer!
PaymentOrDeathA.6.short: They have named their terms: the price has risen! ${0} now, or they will **KILL** me. They are coming closer!

PaymentOrDeathA.8.full: No, I would rather die. (You must choose this option if you cannot pay. Your Self will be returned to the box.)

Payment2ThanksA.3.full: The dark-cloaked fiends took my payment and disappeared into the night. No carriage conveyed them. I witnessed only the sudden flurry of wings and a cauldron of bats against the full moon.
Payment2ThanksA.3.easy: The evil men in dark cloaks took my money and disappeared into the night. No carriage took them away. I only saw a sudden storm of wings and a cloud of bats in front of the full moon.
Payment2ThanksA.3.short: The dark-cloaked fiends took my payment and vanished, not by carriage, but in a flurry of bats against the full moon.

Payment2NoA.3.full: My refusal will most certainly mean my death. I can only hope my will is carried out by those who outlive me.
Payment2NoA.3.easy: If I say no, I will surely die. I can only hope that the people who live after me will do what I wanted.

Payment2NoA.4.full: A pox on my family! They have doomed me to oblivion just as victory was within my grasp!
Payment2NoA.4.easy: Curse my family! They have destroyed me, just when victory was in my hands!

Payment2NoA.5.full: Return your **Self** piece to the game box. It cannot be retrieved for the remainder of the game.

LiberalReplace.3.full: The town's evolution has been a linear one towards relative peace, and this is in part due to the peace of mind that a mental health institute provides.
LiberalReplace.3.easy: The town has developed in a straight line towards a fairly peaceful life, and this is partly because a hospital for the mind makes people feel safe.
LiberalReplace.3.short: The town has moved steadily towards peace, partly thanks to the reassurance of a mental health institute.

LiberalReplace.4.full: The Asylum has expanded not only their facilities, but their influence over the hearts and minds of the townsfolk. The former being not very difficult to do, I should say. However, it appears to be in good standing.
LiberalReplace.4.easy: The Asylum has made its buildings bigger, and it also has more influence on the hearts and minds of the townspeople. I must say that the second part was not very hard. But it seems to have a good reputation.
LiberalReplace.4.short: The Asylum has grown in size and in influence over the townsfolk, not a difficult feat. It appears to be in good standing.

LiberalReplace.5.full: I believe a Dr. Vlad Dracula has taken over as the head of the Asylum Program. I have heard positive things about him.
LiberalReplace.5.easy: I believe a Dr. Vlad Dracula is now the head of the Asylum Program. I have heard good things about him.

LiberalReplace.6.full: They have even embraced this idea of rehabilitation so fully that they are willing to send anyone for a general checkup when needed. LiberalReplace.6.easy: They believe in healing so much that they will send anyone for a general check when it is needed. I am sure our colleagues who study the shape of the skull might laugh at that. But it is nice to know that the punishment for going too far will be less strict.
LiberalReplace.6.short: They now send anyone for a checkup when needed. Our phrenologist colleagues may laugh, but it is good to know that pushing the envelope will be punished less severely.

JailEvent1c.3.full: {0} has made one exception due to the previous generation and my **family's willingness to fund the Asylum**. They will continue to honor this pledge of service when we visit the Junk Palace.
JailEvent1c.3.easy: {0} has made one exception because of the last generation and because my **family was willing to give money to the Asylum**. They will continue to keep this promise of service when we visit the Junk Palace.

JailEvent1c.8.full: What will I do with this useless addition to my Estate now that the Asylum is no longer in operation? Surely a waste of energy to renovate such a specific extension. Better to dispose of it than to let it decay out of disuse.
JailEvent1c.8.easy: What will I do with this useless new part of my house now that the Asylum is closed? It would surely be a waste of energy to rebuild such a special room. It is better to get rid of it than to let it fall apart because nobody uses it.
JailEvent1c.8.short: What use is this extension now that the Asylum has closed? Better to remove it than let it decay.

EndtotheCount.3.full: Due to recent events which have wrecked my investments and coated this village in a grimy filth, I find myself unable to procure fresh blood, as it were. With the region so tainted, I must renounce my involvement in the proceedings. I feel a deep regret at the suddenness of my departure, but my services are needed elsewhere.
EndtotheCount.3.easy: Recent events have destroyed my investments and covered this village in dirty filth, so I cannot get fresh blood, so to speak. Because the region is so spoiled, I must stop taking part in these matters. I am very sorry to leave so suddenly, but I am needed somewhere else.
EndtotheCount.3.short: Recent events have wrecked my investments and fouled this village; I can no longer procure fresh blood, as it were. I must withdraw. I regret the suddenness, but I am needed elsewhere.

PrivateInvestors.2.full: Finances: Investments in {0} by my parents have matured. I now own a substantial entrepreneurial stake in the village.
PrivateInvestors.2.easy: Money: The investments my parents made in {0} have grown. I now own a large part of the businesses in the village.

PrivateInvestors.3.full: I note this because I find it peculiar. Most of my family's investments are diversified amongst various trading interests in the Mediterranean, a very common theme even if I find it terribly dull. This new portfolio will directly increase my coffers; I pray it is the stimulus I need to advance my work more swiftly.
PrivateInvestors.3.easy: I write this down because I find it strange. Most of my family's investments are spread over different trade businesses in the Mediterranean. This is very common, even if I find it terribly boring. This new investment will put money directly into my pockets. I hope it gives me the push I need to move my work forward faster.
PrivateInvestors.3.short: This is peculiar: my family's money is mostly in dull Mediterranean trade. This new stake fills my coffers directly; I hope it speeds my work.

PrivateInvestors.4.full: Retrieve the Player {icon:S2_ColoredMoneyToken} tokens from the Scenario box and give one to each player in their color. Starting with the player with the fewest VP and then to the next lowest, and so on, each player places their token on a Town Location of their choice. *If there is a tie, it is broken by turn order.*

PrivateInvestors.5.full: When you visit a Location with a {icon:S2_ColoredMoneyToken} token in another player's color, you must **pay $1** to the owner of that token.

PrivatetoJail.2.easy: I have just come back from a visit to the Asylum, or what they now call the {0} Jail

PrivatetoJail.3.full: under Count Vlad III Dracula's stewardship

PrivatetoJail.4.full: . Hastily built brick structures house hundreds of unfortunate wretches, deviants, and criminals alike, their mental afflictions varied and jumbled together. The grounds are in stark disrepair, and upon visitation, the noxious odors of unwashed and decaying flesh, human excrement, and drugged patients shackled to their bedding permeated throughout the complex.
PrivatetoJail.4.easy: . Brick buildings, built in a hurry, hold hundreds of poor, unhappy people, people with strange habits, and criminals, all with different illnesses of the mind, all mixed together. The grounds are in very bad condition. When I visited, the whole place was full of terrible smells: unwashed and rotting flesh, human waste, and drugged patients chained to their beds.
PrivatetoJail.4.short: . Hastily built brick blocks hold hundreds of wretches, deviants and criminals, all jumbled together. The grounds are in ruins, and the stench of rot, filth and drugged, shackled patients fills the complex.

PrivatetoJail.5.full: Needless to say, I feel little remorse in utilizing this ghastly place as a continued testing ground. Perhaps it would even improve the inmates' quality of life to know that their involuntary assistance will advance science forever.
PrivatetoJail.5.easy: Of course, I do not feel very sorry about using this horrible place for my experiments. Maybe it would even make the prisoners' lives better to know that their help, even if they did not choose to give it, will move science forward forever.
PrivatetoJail.5.short: Needless to say, I have no qualms about using this ghastly place for testing. Perhaps the inmates would take comfort in advancing science forever.

PrivatetoJail.6.full: Turn to page **8** of the Village Chronicle.

FOTU-End5.3.full: Sunday: I had the glorious dream again - it never fails to reinvigorate me, as I could relive that moment each night for the remainder of my years and be content.
FOTU-End5.3.easy: Sunday: I had the wonderful dream again. It always gives me new energy. I could live that moment again every night for the rest of my life and be happy.
FOTU-End5.3.short: Sunday: the glorious dream again. I could relive that moment every night for the rest of my life and be content.

FOTU-End5.4.full: I watch with steady eyes as my family's creation, {0}, with cathartic ambivalence, lifts the severed head of {1} high into the air. I feel the searing heat of burning oil, hear the hiss of rising steam and smoke, and smell the rusted iron in the air. The crowded arena cheered even as their leader was torn from his makeshift throne and tossed lifeless to the dusty Earth, blood pooling beneath, dark and thick as motor oil.
FOTU-End5.4.easy: I watch with calm eyes as my family's creation, {0}, lifts the cut-off head of {1} high into the air, without strong feelings either way. I feel the burning heat of hot oil, I hear the hiss of rising steam and smoke, and I smell rusty iron in the air. The full arena cheered, even as their leader was pulled from his simple throne and thrown dead onto the dusty ground. Blood collected under him, dark and thick like motor oil.
FOTU-End5.4.short: I watch, steady-eyed, as my family's creation, {0}, lifts the severed head of {1} high. Burning oil, hissing steam, the smell of rust. The arena cheered as their leader was torn from his throne and thrown lifeless to the ground, his blood dark as motor oil.

FOTU-End5.5.full: These images appear in my mind like light on silver even as my weathered hands strain to grasp the quill. My last act of defiance, perhaps. But what is the worth of toppling a regional tyrant? All this effort to shake the world, and barely one square kilometer has been rattled.
FOTU-End5.5.easy: These pictures appear in my mind like an old photograph, even while my old hands try hard to hold the pen. Maybe it is my last act of resistance. But what is it worth to bring down a local ruler? So much effort to shake the world, and only one square kilometer has been moved.
FOTU-End5.5.short: These images stay vivid as my old hands struggle with the quill. But what is toppling a local tyrant worth? All that effort to shake the world, and barely a square kilometer rattled.

FOTU-End5.6.full: The inmates have moved on. The town is an empty, ruined field without vegetation; a decaying pile of ash, rust, and mud. Some days my mind feels the same. The sense of peace does nothing to stem this emptiness of purpose inside of me.
FOTU-End5.6.easy: The prisoners have left. The town is an empty field in ruins, with no plants: a rotting pile of ash, rust, and mud. Some days my mind feels the same. The peace does not fill this feeling inside me that I have no purpose.
FOTU-End5.6.short: The inmates have gone. The town is a barren heap of ash, rust and mud, and some days my mind feels the same. Peace does not fill this emptiness of purpose.

FOTU-End5.7.full: An old man visits now and then; a friend of the family with a withered face that he keeps wrapped tightly with a scarf.
FOTU-End5.7.easy: An old man visits from time to time. He is a friend of the family, with a dry, wrinkled face that he keeps tightly covered with a scarf.

FOTU-End5.8.full: What a waste contentment is! What a terrible investment! I only hope my progeny will leave this broken land behind and forge a new path.
FOTU-End5.8.easy: What a waste it is to be content! What a terrible investment! I only hope my children will leave this broken land and find a new path.
FOTU-End5.8.short: Contentment is such a waste! I hope my heirs leave this broken land and forge a new path.

FOTU-End6.3.full: The customs of Transylvania are even stranger than I remember. I had vague recollections from my youth of being schooled in our home and shielded from the smoky village residing deep in that valley, but I could not have guessed the true reasoning behind it all.
FOTU-End6.3.easy: The traditions of Transylvania are even stranger than I remember. I remembered a little from when I was young that I had lessons at home and was kept away from the smoky village deep in that valley, but I could never have guessed the real reason for it all.
FOTU-End6.3.short: Transylvania's customs are stranger than I remember. As a child I was schooled at home, kept from the smoky village in the valley, but I never guessed why.

FOTU-End6.4.full: I have forged an alliance with the local government based on my parent's good will. They have democratically elected {0} and have even offered to provide materials and assistance for my continued experimentations. I would understand your initial apprehension at the moniker of {1}, but I assure you that the title is derived from a regional dialect and is part of tradition. They have even fashioned a gaming arena of sorts within the town proper, where a particularly aggressive form of sparring is practiced.
FOTU-End6.4.easy: I have made an alliance with the local government, thanks to the good name of my parents. The people have elected {0} in a democratic vote, and they have even offered materials and help for my experiments. I understand if you are worried at first by the name {1}, but I promise you, the title comes from a local language and is part of tradition. They have even built a kind of games arena in the town itself, where people practice a very aggressive kind of fighting.
FOTU-End6.4.short: My parents' good will has won me an alliance with the local government, which democratically elected {0} and offers materials and help for my experiments. The name {1} is just regional tradition, I assure you. They have even built an arena for a particularly aggressive form of sparring.

FOTU-End6.5.full: In fact, I find this region to be surprisingly inclusive and accepting of the avant-garde, which suits my needs as you might expect. I have even scheduled a meeting this weekend with a local Count. He claims to have been a friend of the family and has resumed interest in business ventures within the district.
FOTU-End6.5.easy: In fact, I find that this region is surprisingly open and accepts new and unusual ideas, which suits my needs, as you can imagine. I have even planned a meeting this weekend with a local Count. He says he was a friend of the family, and he is interested again in business projects in the district.
FOTU-End6.5.short: In fact, the region is surprisingly accepting of the avant-garde, which suits me. This weekend I meet a local Count, a supposed family friend interested in new ventures.

FOTU-End3.3.full: If you can smell the scent of tea and rich pastries on this paper before you, it is because I write this letter to you from one of my favorite shops along the main street. The shuffling footsteps and metal din of automobiles along concrete allows my thoughts to wander. I find it disagreeably bright in these parts nowadays, but at least they serve a damn fine cuppa. There are definite benefits to traveling merchants offering a steady supply of fine goods.
FOTU-End3.3.easy: If you can smell tea and rich cakes on this paper, it is because I am writing this letter to you from one of my favorite shops on the main street. The sound of people walking and the metal noise of cars on the concrete let my thoughts wander. I find it unpleasantly bright here these days, but at least they make a really good cup of tea. Traveling traders who bring a steady supply of fine goods certainly have their advantages.
FOTU-End3.3.short: If this paper smells of tea and pastries, it is because I write from a favorite shop on the main street, lulled by footsteps and motorcars. It is disagreeably bright these days, but the tea is excellent, thanks to the traveling merchants.

FOTU-End3.4.full: It appears we have emerged from the dismal environs of yesteryear into a full springtime bloom. My family may have made a few missteps, but it seems their kind-hearted souls (of which I was not aware) won the day and assuaged the fears of the populace. I will say that it is rather enjoyable to sketch out new scientific diagrams in broad daylight without scrutiny.
FOTU-End3.4.easy: It seems we have come out of the sad times of the past into a full spring of flowers. My family may have made a few mistakes, but it seems their kind souls (which I did not know about) won in the end and calmed the fears of the people. I must say it is quite nice to draw new scientific plans in full daylight, without anyone watching me suspiciously.
FOTU-End3.4.short: We have emerged from the gloom of yesteryear into full spring. My family made missteps, but their unexpectedly kind hearts calmed the people's fears. It is pleasant to sketch new diagrams in daylight, unscrutinized.

FOTU-End3.5.full: There are even some willing to volunteer their time towards my "eccentric hobbies" as they call them. Such insufferable fools. I will take pleasure in exploiting their ignorance. But, I will try to be sensible about it - it is unseasonable weather for painful howling.
FOTU-End3.5.easy: Some people even want to give their time to help with my "strange hobbies", as they call them. Such unbearable fools. I will enjoy using their ignorance for my own goals. But I will try to be sensible about it: the weather is not right for painful howling.
FOTU-End3.5.short: Some even volunteer for my "eccentric hobbies". Insufferable fools; I will enjoy exploiting them. Sensibly, though: it is unseasonable weather for painful howling.

FOTU-End3.6.full: Anyway, send my best wishes to your mother and do not tarry too long.
FOTU-End3.6.easy: Anyway, send my best wishes to your mother and do not stay away too long.

FOTU-End4.3.full: It finally happened. They destroyed it all. Mobs with actual torches and pitchforks, I tell you, knocked down my properly erected fencing and stormed the estate, destroying my parents' work. The curs had the audacity to arrive unannounced; had I not heard the hounds eviscerating several members of the crowd, I may not have escaped before being swallowed up by the flames.
FOTU-End4.3.easy: It finally happened. They destroyed everything. Angry crowds with real torches and pitchforks, I tell you, knocked down my well-built fence, attacked the house, and destroyed my parents' work. The dogs did not even tell me they were coming. If I had not heard the dogs tearing apart several people in the crowd, I might not have escaped before the flames took me.
FOTU-End4.3.short: It finally happened. Mobs with real torches and pitchforks broke down my fence, stormed the estate and destroyed my parents' work. Had I not heard the hounds tearing into them, I might not have escaped the flames.

FOTU-End4.4.full: The grounds still remain fallow and singed by ash, enveloping the plot in a vast, dreary grayness. My entreaties to the governor have been met with indifference and ridicule. It is clear that I will receive no financial remuneration for this riotous behavior. Am I to be forever punished for the sins of my father?
FOTU-End4.4.easy: The land is still empty and burned by ash, and the whole place is covered in a huge, sad grayness. When I asked the governor for help, he did not care and laughed at me. It is clear that nobody will pay me for the damage from this riot. Must I be punished forever for the sins of my father?
FOTU-End4.4.short: The grounds lie barren and ash-gray. The governor met my pleas with indifference and ridicule; I will get nothing. Am I forever punished for my father's sins?

FOTU-End4.5.full: No matter! What do they know of loss? I have lost everything. My family's legacy is in tatters. They drive us away as if we are the outsiders, like foreign beggars.
FOTU-End4.5.easy: It does not matter! What do they know about losing things? I have lost everything. My family's name is destroyed. They chase us away as if we were the strangers, like beggars from another country.
FOTU-End4.5.short: No matter! I have lost everything; my family's legacy is in tatters. They drive us out like foreign beggars.

FOTU-End4.6.full: This is not over. I will have vengeance. This paltry village will rue the day it crossed, {0}, the Fourth!
FOTU-End4.6.easy: This is not over. I will have revenge. This poor little village will be sorry for the day it went against {0}, the Fourth!

FOTU-End4.7.full: Also, if you would be so kind as to furnish me a small loan, it would certainly expedite my ability to obtain said revenge.
FOTU-End4.7.easy: Also, if you would be so kind as to give me a small loan, it would certainly help me get that revenge faster.

Oddly enough, my parents invested in the construction of the wall - for reasons unknown to me but reasons nonetheless. IsoBricksRes.2.short: A tidbit for you: oddly, my parents funded the wall. It has eased the hostility I meet when entering that lunatic asylum they call a town.
